overview_description.description:
Boonio is a professional services marketplace, focusing on B2B services procurement. Boonio enhances the end-to-end procurement process by integrating crowdsourcing at the RFI stage, and benefits realization after the delivery stage, to assess the impact firms make on their clients. Additionally, Boonio provides services firms a storefront to sell their prepackaged services and market their proposals, as well as providing a platform for collaboration between clients, firms, and freelancers.

Boonio aims to be the global one-stop-shop for clients looking to discover firms to work with and services firms building brands and marketing their services.

Boonio’s target market is small to medium size services firms and client firms of all sizes.
